author: young.onion
title: Hiring Kawaii Artists for Stationery Collection
content:
🎨 WE ARE HIRING KAWAII ARTISTS! ✨🐾

Calling all creators of all things cute, pastel, and absolutely adorable! 🥰 We are on the lookout for talented artists to bring their kawaii magic to our upcoming stationery collection! 📓✍️💖

If you love drawing chubby characters, happy little stationery, and sweet pastel doodles, we want to see your work! From journals and stickers to washi tapes and pens, let’s make something magical together. ✨

How to apply:

① Make sure you're following us [ @young.onion ]!

② Drop a comment below with your favorite emoji and tag an artist friend who needs to see this! 👇

③ Send us a DM with a link to your portfolio or fill out the application form in our bio! 📂✨

You can also mail us info@youngonion.in

Can't wait to see your cute art! Let’s create something amazing! 🌸💫

Tag a friend who has the perfect kawaii art style! 👇💕

author: dimension11studios
title: Hiring Character Artist for Legends of Orisha
content:
WE'RE HIRING!🎨

We're looking for a Character Artist to join the team working on Legends of Orisha: Blood and Water.

If you're skilled in 3D character modelling, sculpting, texturing, and Unreal Engine, this could be a great fit!

Experience with MetaHuman, realistic 4C hair, African hairstyles, and character materials is a big plus.

📍 Remote
🤝 Long-term collaboration

Interested? Find the full job description and application details through the link in our bio.

Know someone who fits? Tag them or share this post!

author: whenthesilentbirdsings
title: Hiring Comic Artists, Lineartists and More
content:
HIRING COMIC ARTISTS, WRITERS & MORE ⤵️

We’re looking for help with “When the Silent Bird Sings” and other studio projects.

These positions include:
Lineartist, sketch artist, colorist, storyboard artist, animators, music producers, language translators, comic writers/editors, personal assistants, video/reel editors/promoters, content creators & more.

These positions are paid but we’re open to collaboration / internships.

If you meet the requirements listed, then please send a *PROFESSIONAL* email to:

whenthesilentbirdsings@gmail.com

with the following information:

-Name, general location
-Position applying for
-Resume/Portfolio with previous & current experience & examples
-Rate per panel & for 60 panels (+/-)
-Rates for services/etc. (be open to negotiations if necessary)
-Turnaround Time for 60 panels/other work
-Programs / Software used (Clip Studio Paint, etc)
-Preferred Payment Method (However, PayPal is what we will use)
-Other notable experience / specializations

*NO DEADLINE, ROLLING APPLICATION ACCEPTANCE*

‼️ ABSOLUTELY NO AI USE IN THE PROCESS OR FINAL DELIVERABLES. ‼️
